chunks: And Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim narrated from Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, peace be upon him,
that Ali, peace be upon him, disliked the sale of meat in exchange for live animals.

key_terms.أَبِيهِ: his father, referring to the previous Imam in the sanad
key_terms.جَعْفَرِ: Ja'far ibn Muhammad, the transmitting Imam in the chain
key_terms.عَلِيًّا: Imam Ali عليه السلام, whose ruling is being reported
key_terms.غِيَاثُ: Ghiyath, the named narrator at the beginning of the sanad

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali عليه السلام say about selling meat in exchange for a live animal?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Imam Ali عليه السلام disapproved of selling meat in exchange for a live animal. It is cited in the context of financial law and indicates a ruling connected to transactions that may involve riba or problematic exchange.
